packageRules.description: Third-party actions run with the repo's secrets, so they're pinned to a commit (CodeQL flags tags, which can be moved); Renovate keeps the pins current. GitHub's own actions stay on tags.
The site (site/) runs astro check, which doesn't support TypeScript 7 yet. The build at the root already uses 7. Drop this once @astrojs/check supports it.
The site's undici override (site/pnpm-workspace.yaml) patches Miniflare's undici 7, which it pins: keep it on 7, and remove it once Wrangler ships a patched 7.
